cohort: 270 pregnant women attending antenatal care at the two largest tertiary hospitals in Enugu, Nigeria
finding: Sexual function declines as pregnancy advances, and the rate of sexual dysfunction is high in Enugu, Nigeria.
mod_finding: A previous history of cesarean section was a risk factor for sexual dysfunction during pregnancy (AdjOR: 2.1; 95%CI: 1.7-2.6; P: 0.004).
